content: sentence-transformers pypi v5.6.0 (verified). Recommended small local CPU-friendly model for RAG: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (384-dim, ~80MB, fast) as default; BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 as a stronger-quality alternative still small enough for CPU. Static embedding models (attention-free) exist for even faster CPU inference at some quality cost.
